verdict.rationale: Asynchronous human approval of agent transactions is a fair axis for an auth product, but the evidence pack never documents CIBA, backchannel authentication, or any approval flow that pauses an agent's action. MFA with TOTP or phone and Postgres auth hooks are related sign-in controls and building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require asynchronous human approval (e.g. CIBA-style confirmation) before an autonomous agent completes a sensitive transaction
